title: driftkings
author: driftkings
changelog: Development candidate 0.1.7-beta.2 for World of Tanks 2.4.2.0. Production validation is in progress.
Added a hangar footer launcher, with updated launcher and account icons.
Integrated native Gameface for hangar clock, Marks of Excellence, crew progression, carousel statistics and post-battle efficiency. Several battle HUD components share a native window.
Added a cross-server saved-email notice and explicit consent for Tour Coin purchases.
Updated the minimap enhancements panel and launcher hover behaviour, relative to 0.1.7-beta.1.
